selectedFunctions.label: LlamaPay cancelStream
warnings: Static deployment/source/ABI inventory only, not proof of current runtime bytecode identity, execution success, funding, liquidity, complete workflows or financial safety. Zero native value is required; independent grants, pauses, canonical-calldata and safety controls remain authoritative.

Only the fixed Ethereum USDC LlamaPay streaming instance 0x3e67cc2c7fff86d9870db9d02c43e789b52fb296 is admitted. Official live Ethereum factory 0xde1C04855c2828431ba637675B6929A684f84C7F getter getLlamaPayContractByToken(USDC) returned this address with isDeployed=true; exact-address Sourcify ABI/source and explorer token() bind USDC. This is salary stream accounting and claim functionality, not a bare token-transfer integration or arbitrary executor.

deposit and combined depositAndCreate methods spend caller-owned USDC base units (6 decimals) using allowance to this instance and credit only caller payer accounting. amountPerSec, balances and withdrawPayer(amount) instead use internal 20-decimal units; DECIMALS_DIVISOR=100000000000000 converts between units. withdrawPayer divides its internal-unit amount down, and withdrawPayerAll removes the caller available balance after accrued obligations, not other payers funds.

createStream and reason variants create a positive-rate stream identified by payer msg.sender, recipient and exact uint216 rate; an identical active stream is rejected. Existing payer accrued obligations must be fully covered before a new stream can be created. Streams have no encoded maturity or end date; caller must cancel/pause/modify explicitly. createStream does not itself fund future obligations. Combined methods atomically deposit then create; a failure reverts both.

withdraw can be triggered by anyone, but exact (from,to,amountPerSec) must identify an existing stream and payout always goes to its recorded to address. Payment is limited to elapsed funded time across all streams of that payer; underfunding advances only to the common paid timestamp and leaves remaining unpaid time, with no automatic loan or funding guarantee. Integer division floors USDC payment; a small claim can send zero while advancing time, discarding fractional-token dust. No caller-set minimum output, maximum input or deadline exists.

pauseStream and cancelStream both invoke the same _cancelStream: settle the currently funded portion to its existing recipient, remove the stream and reduce payer rate. Pause is not a special resumable state; recreation is a new stream. Underfunded cancellation does not guarantee all past salary will be paid. modifyStream atomically cancels the old caller-owned stream (paying old recipient) then creates the new recipient/rate; failure reverts the full change.

Reason strings are emitted only in StreamCreatedWithReason; they are not decoded as instructions or external calls. Opaque self-delegatecall batch(bytes[],bool) and permitToken arbitrary-token authorization wrapper remain excluded; no callback/admin/approval capability is granted. All selected transfers use the constructor-fixed USDC token with no user-selected external execution target. The reviewed instance has no own pause, role, KYC, blacklist or upgrade entry; USDC issuer restrictions and applicable jurisdictional eligibility still remain outside this inventory.
